info.name: Race Player Stats
info.author: AcidbRain
info.description: Manages and stores player race statistics

setting.name: *welcomeMessage
setting.desc: Message shown to each player after joining the server.
setting.examples: Welcome to the server. Type /stats to see your stats.

setting.name: *messageColor
setting.desc: Html color code of chat messages.

setting.name: *messageHeaderColor
setting.desc: Html color code of chat message headers.

setting.name: *countMidraceJoinAsRacestart
setting.friendlyname: Count mid-race join as race start
setting.desc: Sets whether to consider a mid-race join as a race start

setting.name: *countPostFinishDeath
setting.desc: Sets whether to count player death after they finish a race

setting.name: *vehicleWreckHealthLimit
setting.desc: Count vehicle wrecks only when vehicle health is below this value

setting.name: *statsGracePeriod
setting.desc: Time in seconds before player stats can be saved

setting.name: *serverKey
setting.desc: Unique identifier for this server, used when exporting stats to an external target.
